newsitem.title: FRANCE: Syrian leaders visit Algiers to build Arab support.
newsitem.headline: Syrian leaders visit Algiers to build Arab support.

text.p: Syria's Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara arrived in Algiers on Sunday to build up support for Syria's stand in the Middle East peace process, Algerian state-run radio said.
The Syrian officials were greeted upon arrival at Algiers airport by Algeria's Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf and other officials, it said.
President Liamine Zeroual is expected to meet Khaddam and Shara later, the radio said.

Khaddam began a tour of Arab countries this week to build up Arab backing for Syria's stand in its political deadlock with Israel. Israel broke off talks after a wave of Islamist bombings in Israel last February and March.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, elected last May, rejects Syria's demand that Israel return the Golan Heights -- a strategic plateau towering over both countries and captured by Israel in the 1967 Middle East war.
